title: 独立型屋外らせん階段
description: 中心柱と各段の接続スリーブ・下面放射梁を備えた、直階段とは異なるらせん経路の階段外観。十四枚の実厚段板、踏面リブ、縁帯、取付靴付き外側ガード、連続らせん手すりと中桟、補強した上部踊り場、ベース板とボルトを造形。柱と各段は実形状の部材で接続されています。上部の接続先床・建物・地面・人は含みません。踊り場の開放された接続辺と高さをシーン側で調整する配置用です。隠れた基礎アンカー、排水穴、溶接ビード、細かなねじ山は省略。歩行・避難・耐荷重・転落防止・アクセシビリティ・建築基準の認証はなく、施工・利用案内ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.200 × 4.045 × 2.370 m、51,676三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A spiral-route stair appearance assembly materially different from a straight stair, with a continuous central column, fourteen thick radial treads connected through real sleeves and underside radial beams, raised tread strips, edge markings, shoe-mounted outer guards, continuous helical handrail/midrail and a reinforced top landing. Treads visibly connect to the column through modeled structural members. No receiving floor, building, ground or person is included; align the open landing connection edge and height in the host scene. Concealed foundation anchors, drainage holes, weld beads and tiny screw threads are omitted. No walking, evacuation, load, fall-protection, accessibility or building-standard certification is supplied. This is not installation or human-use guidance. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.200 × 4.045 × 2.370 m; 51,676 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
